Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Just a reminder that Bangladesh Under-19 will have to chase down the target within 38.1 overs in order to qualify for the semi-finals. The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Ashiqur Rahman Shibli and Jishan Alam are the openers for Bangladesh Under-19. Ubaid Shah to start with the new ball. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Bangladesh Under-19 have to chase 156 runs in 38.1 overs or less to keep their ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup hopes alive. It won't be an easy task, as the Pakistani batters have struggled, and so will the Bangladeshi batters. Which side will make their way into the semis? Stay tuned as the run-chase is up next...

Md Rohanat Doullah Borson is up for a chat. He says that he has used the wicket as per the conditions. On his celebrations, he says that is is all emotions for him. Adds that he told the captain that he won't go for the bouncer to the tall man and stuck to the yorker out of anger after being hit for a boundary. which rewarded him well.

Pakistan Under-19 will certainly be upset with how things ended for them. They kept losing wickets whenever a partnership was brewing for them. Yes, the pitch always had some purchase for the bowlers, but it was certainly not an 155 runs wicket. They will now hope for their bowlers to pick early wickets and put some pressure on the Bangladesh side early on.

Well, well, Bangladesh Under-19 have restricted Pakistan Under-19 to a low total of 155 runs, and now they believe! So the equation now is that they have to chase this total in 38.1 overs or less to make their way into the semi-finals. Their bowlers were excellent, not to mention their fielding was also on point! Sheikh Paevez Jibon and Md Rohanat Doullah Borson were the pick of the bowlers for Bangladesh, as they picked up a four-fer.

OUT! STUMPED! Pakistan Under-19 are wrapped up for 155 runs! Mahfuzur Rahman serves it short and slow around off. Arafat Minhas dances down the track looking to go for another big shot. He misses the ball completely and the keeper. Ashiqur Rahman Shibli is quick to collect the ball. He brings out some clean glovework and takes off the bails while Minhas is short of his crease. It is done and suited for Pakistan Under-19 in this innings and they managed to put up only 155 runs on the board.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set to begin as the umpires and the players stride out in the middle and line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Bangladesh's first, followed by the national anthem of Pakistan. Right then, we are done with the pre-match proceedings. The players of Bangladesh Under-19 are now seen in a huddle, near the ropes, before they take their respective field positions. Shamyl Hussain and Shahzaib Khan are the two openers for Pakistan Under-19. Md Iqbal Hasan Emon will start with the new ball. Let's go...

Pitch report - Nice breeze is blowing across the stadium. The square boundaries are on the shorter side compared to the straight ones. It's a fresh track and there is a bit of live grass. A hard surface to bat on and the fast bowlers can exploit the conditions initially. The spinners will also come into play, perhaps more in the second innings.

Saad Baig, the captain of Pakistan Under-19, says that it's a different venue and they have to play some good cricket. Calls it a big game and they want to win. Informs that Mohammad Zeeshan is back in the XI, replacing Amir Hassan.

Mahfuzur Rahman, the skipper of Bangladesh Under-19, says that they will bowl first. He adds that there is a bit of moisture in the surface, and that will help their bowlers. He further says that they have played Pakistan Under-19 before, and his side will look to do well today. He ends by informing that they are unchanged.

Pakistan are currently in second place in their group, while Bangladesh are just two points behind. If Bangladesh win, they could tie with Pakistan, and the net run rate would come into play. However, if Pakistan win, they will secure their spot in the semi-finals. The race for the semi-finals is heating up in the 2024 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup and next up is a crucial clash in Group 1 of the Super Sixes stage as Asian rivals, Pakistan Under-19 take on Bangladesh Under-19 in Match number 10 at Willowmoore Park in Benoni. Pakistan Under-19 currently sit in second place in their group and that will be good enough to seal a semi-final spot but Bangladesh Under-19 are just two points behind them and could go level on points with a win here which is the decisive Super Sixes game for both teams and if that happens, the net run rate will come into play. But if Pakistan Under-19 win, they will be safely into the semis. Pakistan Under-19 have been spotless thus far with all wins and no losses but most of the wins were against teams one would expect them to beat. The victory against New Zealand though was quite special as they bundled out the opposition for just 140 runs and chased it down with all 10 wickets intact. They do come into this contest on the back of a hard-fought win against Ireland where their bowlers once again did a stellar job but the batters were made to work really hard before eventually sealing the contest. Bangladesh Under-19 are on a three-match winning streak as well since that opening game loss to reigning champions India and they have brushed aside the likes of Ireland, the USA, and most recently Nepal with ease. The bowlers set up the game as they bowled out Nepal for 169 runs and then they got over the line having lost five wickets. In recent times, at this level and the senior level, a match-up between Pakistan and Bangladesh has been seen as a bit of a newly-formed rivalry and both sides will give it their all as they look to stamp their authority in the final four of the competition.
